tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Brand maroon, sampled from every logo file. The disc inside the avatar ring, banner grounds, wordmark ink on light grounds. 11:1 against white.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold, sampled from every logo file. The avatar ring, wordmark ink on maroon and black. 8:1 on maroon, 15:1 on black. Never as text on white (1.4:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Black in the primary dark theme (as behind the stacked logo), white in light.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Full maroon fields: banners, headers, hero bands, the business card face. Set text on it in on-brand or white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface (21:1 both themes). White also reads on surface-brand (11:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface. Dark 9.1:1 on black (4.8:1 on maroon); light 7.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Display headings and wordmark-style type on surface: gold on black, maroon on white, matching the gold and maroon logo variants.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Display text on surface-brand (gold on maroon, 8:1), as in the banners.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill such as a primary button (maroon on gold, 8:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers on surface; 4.2:1 on black and on white, so it passes the 3:1 floor for control borders.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px. Gold on black (15:1), maroon on white (11:1). On surface-brand use gold in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success status (Okabe-Ito blue, off the red-green axis). Text on surface: 9.1:1 dark, 5.2:1 light. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning status (Okabe-Ito orange). Text on surface: 9.3:1 dark, 5.9:1 light. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error/destructive status. Text on surface: 6.9:1 dark, 5.9:1 light. Told apart from success by hue axis (red vs blue) and always paired with a word or icon.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero titles and banner wordmark-style lines. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles, thumbnail and stream-overlay titles. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and button padding, gaps between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections inside a page or card group.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Clear space around logos and between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs: echoes the softened corners of the HK Modular letterforms.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The avatar ring and anything circular (avatars, status dots).
